description: The location and shape of the North Face Corridor (NFC) in the Great Pyramid of Giza are shown in cross-sectional views of the analysis area including Chevron from the North (a) and East (b) sides. Locations of EM1 to EM4 detectors installed in the DC and obtained results are shown in red, and EM5 to EM7 installed in the MC are shown in black, respectively in b.
